audit_scope: Read-only owner-source/metadata audit plus one explicitly requested tiny artificial planner comparison. No H4 scientific inputs, scientific computations or owner-file changes.

integration.observed_working_tree_status: Integration files staged; further unstaged CLI/WidthDriver changes; draft REPORT/HANDOFF/tests/check outputs untracked. No fixed integration commit yet.
integration.snapshot_warning: Local owner code changed during this audit. These findings describe the listed working-tree blobs, not an immutable published result.

findings.evidence: Named integration branch had no remote ref. Local HEAD is width-only d695; e839 and glue exist only as staged/dirty files.
findings.required: Wait for owner publication, then verify exact remote SHA/tree and relevant fixed artifacts. Do not launch d695 or substitute an older implementation.

findings.detail: The width path does not re-verify/absorb all finished speculative Q3 after executor.finish. A valid cheaper unadopted completion can be omitted from final point state and ROUND_RESULT, especially if no later batch reloads prior_records.
findings.required: Retain adopted minimum separately from minimum of all identity/source/contract-verified completed observations. Reuse existing Executor/prior-record validation or verified ledger; do not treat raw OUTCOME status alone as sufficient.

findings.detail: Latest inspected dirty code honors overlap_ready_batch=true, science_approved=true and not plan_only. It submits complete_points to a thread, runs initially READY Q3 on the same executor while preparation continues, then installs READY records after the whole preparation future returns.
findings.limitation: Newly READY records are not streamed individually while that preparation future is still pending.
findings.required: Actual owned round must explicitly enable overlap_ready_batch. Draft HANDOFF example has false. Owner must publish and validate the new branch; do not describe the earlier sequential snapshot as the current implementation.

findings.detail: WidthDriver now obtains the ordinary legacy/concurrent executor factory, carries the same context/routes/expected IDs and cumulative budget into Completion continuation, and closes its owned executor in finally. Outer width/kappa planner suppresses the independent inner kappa chooser.

findings.evidence: Local REPORT/HANDOFF link SOURCE.json and CHECKS.json under docs/research/pr_width_throughput_integration_20261117; those two files were absent when inspected. Local queue/prefix/B0I check outputs exist, but are untracked and not immutable published evidence.
findings.required: Resolve draft references and publish matching code/test/evidence before selecting a scientific execution SOURCE.

findings.detail: A cheaper PR-Pauli incumbent supplies the global window for PR-DF too. In the artificial reproduction joint planning gives only Pauli REFINE_UP and marks DF RESOLVED, whereas the unchanged DF-only family gives DF REFINE_UP and OPEN. This suppresses DF refinement even when the objective is an independent DF minimum.
findings.required: Keep each method optimization independent: partition families/points by method before applying the existing planner, or introduce an equivalent method-local incumbent/window. Preserve the original rule within each method; any global queue interleave must not veto a method based on another method cost. Add the artificial isolation regression in the owner source before scientific launch.

launch_settings_to_bind.width_representation: Preserve raw binary64 JSON numbers versus exact rational strings; binary64 0.2 and exact "1/5" remain separate families. Keep original h_RPE and T_m.
launch_settings_to_bind.profile_warning: Draft worker/slot/checkpoint numbers are examples, not scientific adoption or permanent resource caps. Use owned run/cache paths and the permitted resource profile.
launch_settings_to_bind.budgets: Bind total scientific scope and cumulative per-method Q3 limits; prefix-assisted evaluation of a new allocation still consumes one new Q3. Only completed-result reuse consumes zero.
launch_settings_to_bind.controls: Keep existing mapper, SOURCE, H/state/snapshot, scalar-once, compiler/lowering, decoder/loss/exact threshold, price law/domain qualifications and one-shot/STOP rules.
launch_settings_to_bind.pending_price_policy: Unsupported widths and incomplete calibration stay explicit waiting/held; no zero price, no cross-width coefficients and no Q3 rejection inferred from preparation diagnostics.
